title: Grade 4 CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — Premium Revision Paper #3

pages.quiz:
CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #3
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 120 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which book of the Bible begins with the words "In the beginning God created the heavens and the earth"? (1 mark)
   A. Luke
   B. Psalms
   C. Exodus
   D. Genesis

2. Which of these can help a child who is sad? (1 mark)
   A. Hiding alone for days
   B. Talking to a trusted adult and praying
   C. Being rude to others
   D. Refusing to eat

3. Which is a healthy way to calm down when you feel angry? (1 mark)
   A. Shout at everyone
   B. Break things
   C. Hit the person
   D. Take deep breaths and count to ten

4. What is a consequence? (1 mark)
   A. A school subject
   B. A type of song
   C. A result of what we choose
   D. A holiday

5. Which person in the Bible chose not to defile himself with the king's food? (1 mark)
   A. Zacchaeus
   B. Daniel
   C. Balaam
   D. Samson

6. Who is included in the nuclear family? (1 mark)
   A. Only grandparents
   B. Parents and their children
   C. Neighbours
   D. Cousins and aunts only

7. What is one warning sign that a situation is unsafe? (1 mark)
   A. You feel proud
   B. You feel uneasy or scared
   C. You feel happy
   D. You feel sleepy

8. Which attribute comforts a child who is lonely? (1 mark)
   A. God is a loving Father who knows us by name
   B. God is angry
   C. God forgets us
   D. God is far away

9. What was Zacchaeus' job? (1 mark)
   A. Priest
   B. Fisherman
   C. Chief tax collector
   D. Shepherd

10. Why did the donkey turn away from the road? (1 mark)
   A. She was tired
   B. She was hungry
   C. She was afraid of Balak
   D. She saw the angel and Balaam did not

11. What did Samson use to kill the lion? (1 mark)
   A. A sword
   B. A stone
   C. His bare hands
   D. A spear

12. What gave Samson the strength to kill the lion? (1 mark)
   A. Special food
   B. The Spirit of the Lord
   C. His long hair alone
   D. His parents

13. What lesson can we learn from Joseph's plan? (1 mark)
   A. Plan and save for hard times
   B. Ignore the future
   C. Spend everything
   D. Take all the food

14. Whom did the angel say was expecting a child in old age? (1 mark)
   A. Ruth
   B. Elizabeth
   C. Hannah
   D. Sarah

15. When were the ten men healed? (1 mark)
   A. Never
   B. Before they heard Him
   C. As they went
   D. After many years

16. What is a widow? (1 mark)
   A. A teacher
   B. A queen
   C. A woman without children
   D. A woman whose husband has died

17. A classmate breaks your pencil by accident. What is the best response? (1 mark)
   A. Tell others lies
   B. Shout at him
   C. Break his pencil
   D. Forgive and accept the apology

18. Who shared five loaves and two fish in John 6? (1 mark)
   A. A soldier
   B. A king
   C. A boy
   D. A priest

19. Which verse tells us to give to the one who asks? (1 mark)
   A. Genesis 1:1
   B. Acts 2:38
   C. John 3:16
   D. Matthew 5:42

20. According to Acts 20:35, what is more blessed? (1 mark)
   A. To buy than to sell
   B. To keep than to give
   C. To sleep than to work
   D. To give than to receive

21. What does the mustard seed stand for? (1 mark)
   A. The end of the world
   B. A rich king
   C. A big city
   D. The small beginning of God's kingdom

22. What does a seed need to grow? (1 mark)
   A. Soil, water and light
   B. Only noise
   C. Only sand
   D. Nothing

23. What does the big tree stand for? (1 mark)
   A. The growth of God's kingdom
   B. A palace
   C. A mountain
   D. A market

24. What does repentance do? (1 mark)
   A. It pushes us away from God
   B. It makes us proud
   C. It draws us close to Christ
   D. It has no effect

25. What is eternal life? (1 mark)
   A. Life with God that never ends
   B. A long holiday
   C. Life on earth only
   D. A kind of food

26. Which helpline can children in Kenya call for help? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 555
   C. 900
   D. 116

27. Which verse says that truthful lips endure for ever? (1 mark)
   A. Proverbs 1:7
   B. Acts 2:38
   C. Proverbs 12:19
   D. John 3:16

28. Which story is a fable about lying but is not in the Bible? (1 mark)
   A. Zacchaeus
   B. Balaam
   C. The shepherd boy and the wolf
   D. Joseph

29. What did Jesus say to the disciples about the children? (1 mark)
   A. They are too small
   B. Send them away
   C. Wait for tomorrow
   D. Let them come to me

30. Which of these shows love at school? (1 mark)
   A. Laughing at new pupils
   B. Welcoming a new pupil
   C. Hiding books
   D. Refusing to greet

31. What are the two greatest commandments? (1 mark)
   A. Buy and sell
   B. Love God and love your neighbour
   C. Pray and fast
   D. Work and rest

32. What did God tell the first man to do in the garden, according to Genesis 2:15? (1 mark)
   A. Leave it
   B. Work it and take care of it
   C. Sell it
   D. Sleep

33. What should you do with a borrowed book? (1 mark)
   A. Return it in good condition
   B. Damage it
   C. Keep it
   D. Sell it

34. What does Luke 16:10 teach? (1 mark)
   A. Money is evil
   B. Be greedy
   C. Do not work
   D. Whoever is trusted with little can be trusted with much

35. Why should we take part in church activities? (1 mark)
   A. To show off
   B. To avoid home
   C. To waste time
   D. To grow spiritually and serve others

36. Who was watching when Stephen was stoned? (1 mark)
   A. Thomas
   B. A young man named Saul
   C. Peter
   D. Balaam

37. What do we ask when we say "forgive us our debts"? (1 mark)
   A. A gift
   B. Money
   C. Bread
   D. Forgiveness of our sins

38. What does self-control mean? (1 mark)
   A. Controlling your words, actions and wishes
   B. Doing whatever you want
   C. Being loud
   D. Being lazy

39. What should you do if something online frightens you? (1 mark)
   A. Keep looking
   B. Close it and tell a trusted adult
   C. Keep it secret
   D. Share it

40. Which number can children call for help in Kenya? (1 mark)
   A. 66
   B. 200
   C. 10
   D. 116

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
41. Explain how repentance draws a person close to Christ and how a child can repent. (5 marks)

42. Where were believers first called Christians? (2 marks)

43. Explain how Luke 16:10 and Genesis 2:15 teach responsibility, and give examples from school and home. (5 marks)

44. List three ways of using money wisely. (3 marks)

45. Name two people you can trust at home or school. (2 marks)

46. Name two needs that people may have. (2 marks)

47. Name two members of the extended family. (2 marks)

48. Explain why Joseph said, "I cannot do it, but God will give Pharaoh the answer". (3 marks)

49. Explain how a child can show appreciation for God's blessings, using what you learned about Abraham. (5 marks)

50. Explain what Proverbs 12:19 means. (3 marks)

51. Explain what the healing of Bartimaeus teaches about Jesus. (3 marks)

52. State two ways of respecting the church building. (2 marks)

53. Describe how the story of the shepherd boy and the wolf shows the results of lying. (4 marks)

54. Explain what the story teaches about the power of Jesus and His care for people. (4 marks)

55. Describe how the ten lepers showed faith. (3 marks)

56. Explain how a child can show compassion at school and at home, and why prayer is important when facing challenges. (5 marks)

57. State two things the angel Gabriel said about the child that Mary would bear. (2 marks)

58. State three results of telling lies. (3 marks)

59. Why did King Balak ask Balaam for help? (2 marks)
pages.answers:
CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #3 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. D — Genesis
   Genesis 1:1 is the opening line of the Bible.

2. B — Talking to a trusted adult and praying
   Sharing feelings with a trusted person and praying helps.

3. D — Take deep breaths and count to ten
   Slowing down helps you to think before acting.

4. C — A result of what we choose
   A consequence is the result of a choice.

5. B — Daniel
   Daniel 1:8 says that he decided not to defile himself.

6. B — Parents and their children
   The nuclear family is the small group of parents and children living together.

7. B — You feel uneasy or scared
   Uneasy feelings are a signal to move away.

8. A — God is a loving Father who knows us by name
   A loving Father cares and knows us.

9. C — Chief tax collector
   Zacchaeus was a chief tax collector.

10. D — She saw the angel and Balaam did not
   The donkey saw what Balaam could not see.

11. C — His bare hands
   He tore it apart with his bare hands.

12. B — The Spirit of the Lord
   The Spirit of the Lord came powerfully upon him.

13. A — Plan and save for hard times
   Joseph advised saving in good years.

14. B — Elizabeth
   Mary's relative Elizabeth was expecting a baby.

15. C — As they went
   Luke 17:14 says they were cleansed as they went.

16. D — A woman whose husband has died
   A widow has lost her husband.

17. D — Forgive and accept the apology
   Forgiveness restores friendship.

18. C — A boy
   A boy's lunch was used to feed a large crowd.

19. D — Matthew 5:42
   Matthew 5:42 says to give to the one who asks.

20. D — To give than to receive
   Acts 20:35 quotes Jesus' words.

21. D — The small beginning of God's kingdom
   God's kingdom began small.

22. A — Soil, water and light
   Seeds need soil, water and light.

23. A — The growth of God's kingdom
   The kingdom grows large.

24. C — It draws us close to Christ
   Repenting means turning to God for a new start.

25. A — Life with God that never ends
   Eternal life is everlasting life with God.

26. D — 116
   Childline Kenya's number is 116.

27. C — Proverbs 12:19
   Proverbs 12:19 says this.

28. C — The shepherd boy and the wolf
   The boy who cried wolf is a fable.

29. D — Let them come to me
   Matthew 19:14 records His welcome.

30. B — Welcoming a new pupil
   Welcoming is kind.

31. B — Love God and love your neighbour
   Matthew 22:37-39.

32. B — Work it and take care of it
   Genesis 2:15 says this.

33. A — Return it in good condition
   Borrowed items must be returned.

34. D — Whoever is trusted with little can be trusted with much
   Faithfulness in small things matters.

35. D — To grow spiritually and serve others
   Participation helps faith to grow.

36. B — A young man named Saul
   Acts 7:58.

37. D — Forgiveness of our sins
   Debts stands for sins.

38. A — Controlling your words, actions and wishes
   Self-control means governing yourself.

39. B — Close it and tell a trusted adult
   Tell someone who can help.

40. D — 116
   Childline Kenya.

SECTION B
----
41. (5 marks)
   Answer: Sin separates us from God. When we are sorry and turn from wrong, God forgives and we draw near to Him. A child can admit wrong, say sorry to God and others, put things right, and decide to do better with the Spirit's help.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for sin separating, 1 for forgiveness, 1 for admitting, 1 for putting right, 1 for deciding to do better.

42. (2 marks)
   Answer: Antioch (Acts 11:26).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for Antioch and 1 for reference or the meaning.

43. (5 marks)
   Answer: Luke 16:10 says being faithful in small things leads to bigger tasks. Genesis 2:15 says God gave people work to do and things to care for. At school a child covers books and cleans the class. At home a child washes plates and looks after younger siblings.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each verse meaning, 1 for a school example, 1 for a home example, 1 for a clear link.

44. (3 marks)
   Answer: Save some, spend on needs first, give to those in need, avoid wasting, do not steal or cheat, keep a record.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid way.

45. (2 marks)
   Answer: Parent, guardian, teacher, counsellor, grandparent.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

46. (2 marks)
   Answer: Food, clothing, shelter, medicine, school items, friendship.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid need.

47. (2 marks)
   Answer: Grandfather, grandmother, uncle, aunt, cousin. Any two.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct member.

48. (3 marks)
   Answer: Joseph knew that wisdom comes from God. He was humble and did not boast. He gave God the honour.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for wisdom from God, 1 for humility, 1 for honouring God.

49. (5 marks)
   Answer: Abraham received God's blessings and passed them on. A child can thank God in prayer for family, food, health and school, share with others, obey God, and be a blessing as Abraham was told to be.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for blessings to Abraham, 1 for thanking God, 1 for examples of blessings, 1 for sharing, 1 for obeying or being a blessing.

50. (3 marks)
   Answer: Truth lasts and is trusted, but lies are soon found out and do not last.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for truth lasting, 1 for lies not lasting, 1 for clear explanation.

51. (3 marks)
   Answer: Jesus has power over sickness. He cares about the poor and those who suffer. He responds to faith.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid point.

52. (2 marks)
   Answer: Enter quietly, do not litter, keep phones silent, take care of Bibles.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

53. (4 marks)
   Answer: The boy lied twice that a wolf was coming. Villagers came and found nothing. When a real wolf came, nobody believed him. Lies destroy trust.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid point up to 4.

54. (4 marks)
   Answer: Jesus has power over death. He cares for the poor and lonely, such as widows. He acts out of compassion. People recognised God at work.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid point up to 4.

55. (3 marks)
   Answer: They called out to Jesus; they obeyed His command to go to the priests before they were healed; one returned to give thanks.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid point.

56. (5 marks)
   Answer: At school: share, comfort a sad classmate, include a lonely child. At home: help with chores, care for a sick family member. Prayer is important because God hears us and helps, and it gives peace and courage.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for a school example, 1 for a home example, 1 for God hearing, 1 for peace or courage, 1 for clear link to compassion.

57. (2 marks)
   Answer: He will be great, He will be called Son of the Most High, He will have the throne of David, His kingdom will never end. Any two.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid statement.

58. (3 marks)
   Answer: Loss of trust, punishment, guilt, broken friendships.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each result.

59. (2 marks)
   Answer: He was afraid of the Israelites and wanted them to be cursed.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for fear and 1 mark for wanting the Israelites cursed.
